# Informed isometry preparation study

Fourteen complete first projects and their edition-2026 manifests were frozen
at baseline `21b58b90dfe9f60b4a3d34d1171df5adf3a7db32` before implementation.
The first 28 text/JSON checks retain actual diagnostics and native invocation
counts. Closed zero preparation and a pure scalar control already passed;
the other sources expose profile limits or intended type/effect/owner errors.

The 28 appended observations use the unchanged source snapshots. Eight Iso
cases and the pure control pass; five intended errors remain rejected. Every
positive check invokes the selected native checker once. These observations
check producer consistency, not an independently specified algorithm meaning.
They do not execute the open functions or prove source preservation.

The [bounded integration packet](../../frontend_v030/isometry-preparation/README.md)
retains independent exact composition requests, complex reference expectations,
native-valid source mutants and actual failed runs. A separately frozen
supplemental source checks two moved initializations and reversed output axes.
Original sources, failures and observations remain unchanged. This is informed
repository development, not a blind model benchmark.
